run_compute_scaling_factors: run compute_scaling_factors to fit and save model scaling factors to a checkpoint file
run_fit_cli: run the scaling fit CLI tool with a config and checkpoint path to compute scale factors
run_train_batch: run a single training batch forward pass and loss computation without gradient updates
review_compute_scaling_factors: review the compute_scaling_factors function that fits ScaleFactor modules in computation order
refactor_train_batch: refactor the _train_batch helper to support custom forward pass and loss computation logic
